# rubrik_objects (Data Source)

The `rubrik_objects` data source is used to look up all RSC hierarchy objects
of a given type. Unlike `rubrik_object`, it does not filter by name — it
returns every matching object.

Supported object types:
  * `AzureNativeResourceGroup` - Azure Native Resource Group (optionally
    scoped to a single subscription with `subscription_id`; omitting it
    searches across all subscriptions managed by RSC)
  * `GlueIcebergCatalog`, `GlueIcebergDatabase` and `GlueIcebergTable` - AWS
    Glue Iceberg catalogs, databases and tables
  * `S3TablesIcebergCatalog`, `S3TablesIcebergNamespace` and
    `S3TablesIcebergTable` - Amazon S3 Tables Iceberg catalogs, namespaces and
    tables

The Apache Iceberg object types can be scoped to the objects below an ancestor,
e.g., the tables in a database, with `parent_id`; omitting it returns every
object of the type managed by RSC. Each returned Iceberg object carries its AWS
region and the ID of its immediate parent.

Additional object types will be added in future releases.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# List every Azure Native Resource Group RSC knows about, across all
# subscriptions it manages.
data "rubrik_objects" "all_resource_groups" {
  object_type = "AzureNativeResourceGroup"
}

output "resource_group_names" {
  value = data.rubrik_objects.all_resource_groups.objects[*].name
}

# Scope the search to a single subscription.
data "rubrik_azure_subscription" "subscription" {
  subscription_id = "31be1bb0-c76c-11eb-9217-afdffe83a002"
}

data "rubrik_objects" "resource_groups_in_subscription" {
  object_type     = "AzureNativeResourceGroup"
  subscription_id = data.rubrik_azure_subscription.subscription.id
}

# List the AWS Glue Iceberg tables in a database.
data "rubrik_object" "glue_database" {
  name        = "sales"
  object_type = "GlueIcebergDatabase"
}

data "rubrik_objects" "glue_tables" {
  object_type = "GlueIcebergTable"
  parent_id   = data.rubrik_object.glue_database.id
}

output "glue_table_names" {
  value = data.rubrik_objects.glue_tables.objects[*].name
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `object_type` (String) Object type. Possible values are `AzureNativeResourceGroup`, `GlueIcebergCatalog`, `GlueIcebergDatabase`, `GlueIcebergTable`, `S3TablesIcebergCatalog`, `S3TablesIcebergNamespace` and `S3TablesIcebergTable`.

### Optional

- `parent_id` (String) RSC object ID of an ancestor object (UUID) to scope the search to, e.g., a Glue database to return its tables. When omitted, every object of the type managed by RSC is returned. Only valid when `object_type` is one of the Apache Iceberg object types.
- `subscription_id` (String) RSC cloud account ID of an Azure subscription (UUID) to scope the search to. When omitted, resource groups across all subscriptions managed by RSC are returned. Only used when `object_type` is `AzureNativeResourceGroup`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) SHA-256 hash of the object type, subscription ID, parent ID and objects returned.
- `objects` (Attributes Set) Objects matching `object_type` (and `subscription_id` or `parent_id`, if specified). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--objects))

<a id="nestedatt--objects"></a>
### Nested Schema for `objects`

Read-Only:

- `id` (String) Object ID (UUID).
- `name` (String) Object name.
- `parent_id` (String) RSC object ID of the immediate parent object (UUID), e.g., the database of a Glue Iceberg table. Only returned for the Apache Iceberg object types.
- `region` (String) AWS region of the object. Only returned for the Apache Iceberg object types.
- `subscription_id` (String) RSC cloud account ID of the parent Azure subscription (UUID). Only returned for `AzureNativeResourceGroup`.
